title: Laboratory-derived inflammatory–nutritional exploratory phenogroups and their associations with functional limitation and 30-day same-center all-cause unplanned readmission in patients with heart failure
summary: K-means clustering of routine admission laboratory data in 1,455 hospitalized patients produced three exploratory phenogroups. Two groups were associated with higher functional limitation and same-center 30-day readmission; this single-center observational result has low cluster separation and no external validation or demonstrated clinical utility.
ai_technology: K-means clustering grouped 15 admission laboratory variables; regression tested associations with clinical outcomes.
organization: Not stated in the reviewed primary full text

evidence.tested: Three phenogroups were reported; two vulnerable groups had adjusted odds ratios of 3.814 and 5.594 for severe functional limitation and 1.966 and 2.616 for same-center 30-day readmission.
evidence.unknown: Single-center observational analysis with low silhouette (0.107), cluster overlap, no external validation, and no demonstrated incremental prediction or clinical utility.
evidence.ai_role: Unsupervised clustering produced exploratory patient groups whose clinical associations were then evaluated.

source_review.scope: Primary source full-text Methods and Results; version date and reported validation scope checked.
